_comment: Per-tenant seccomp profile for red/blue/model (Phase 2 / M2). For the PoC the default action is ALLOW and we ERRNO-block a set of escalation/breakout-adjacent syscalls PLUS a canary (chmod) that the isolation test checks to prove the profile is actually applied. A production hardening would invert this to defaultAction=SCMP_ACT_ERRNO with an explicit allowlist; documented in THREAT_MODEL.md (Phase 4).
